title: All that Jazz Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
meta_description: With a great location on Savannah Street this three bedroom cottage offers comfort, class, and convenience with it's prime Seaside location only a 4 minute walk to the beach with private Savannah Street pavilion
description_expanded: There are beach houses, and then there is "All That Jazz". ✨HOME HIGHLIGHTS✨ • 3 BR | 4 BATH home completely remodeled from the ground up in 2026. Brand-new, elevated coastal design with custom finishes throughout • Beautifully redesigned kitchen with Sub Zero refrigerator and Wolff gas range • Multiple, inviting indoor and outdoor spaces • Beach access to the Private Seaside beach via the Savannah Pavilion • Up to 8 access cards total for private beach access (per Seaside guidelines they will not provide us with more bands than the home sleeps) • Two complimentary beach cruiser bikes • Optional access to Seaside's private pools and fitness center (additional fee applies, see below) • Fully equipped kitchen • Walking distance to the Seaside shops, restaurants and amenities • Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. Welcome to All That Jazz — a completely reimagined Seaside retreat where timeless coastal style meets a little bit of Southern soul. Formerly known as Coquina, this beloved Seaside home has been completely remodeled from the ground up, creating an entirely new vacation experience for today's discerning 30A traveler. From the custom finishes and thoughtfully designed spaces to the beautiful new kitchen and elevated coastal interiors, every detail has been carefully considered to make this home feel special from the moment you walk through the door. All That Jazz is fresh, sophisticated, comfortable and unmistakably Seaside. The heart of the home is a beautifully redesigned, open-concept living space where everyone can gather after a day at the beach. The custom-designed kitchen is both gorgeous and functional, making everything from a quick breakfast before the beach to a family dinner at home feel effortless. High-end finishes, beautiful cabinetry, carefully selected fixtures and designer details give the home a polished look while still keeping it relaxed and welcoming. The home features three beautifully appointed bedrooms, providing plenty of room for families or friends traveling together. Every bedroom has been thoughtfully designed to create a comfortable retreat at the end of a long beach day, while the newly remodeled bathrooms add another layer of luxury and convenience. And then there is the outdoor living. Step outside and enjoy the quintessential Seaside lifestyle from the home's inviting porches and outdoor spaces. Sip your morning coffee, settle in with a good book, or gather together in the evening as the coastal breeze rolls through. At All That Jazz, the pace is easy and the atmosphere is meant for making memories. LOCATION, LOCATION, LOCATION One of the best things about All That Jazz is that you can leave the car behind. Located in Seaside, this home puts you within easy walking distance of the town's famous shops, restaurants, coffee spots, entertainment and iconic beach. You'll also have access to Seaside's private beach through the Savannah Pavilion, making those morning walks to the Gulf wonderfully easy. The home is also conveniently located near two of Seaside's community pools, giving you another option when you're ready to cool off. Seaside offers additional amenities including its town center, playgrounds, tennis, pickleball, croquet and more. Optional access to Seaside's pools and fitness center is also available. And because exploring 30A is even more fun on two wheels, two beach cruiser bicycles are included with your stay. A NEW NAME. A WHOLE NEW HOUSE. The name All That Jazz isn't just a name — it's the feeling you get when you stay here. It's the easy mornings, sandy feet, bikes leaning against the house, dinners together, walks through Seaside and evenings spent on the porch. It's the beautiful details you notice throughout the home and the little touches that make your vacation feel elevated without ever feeling stuffy. The owners, with roots in New Orleans, have been coming to Seaside since the 1980’s. They have always loved the quaint early cottages built on the east side of town. They remind the family of the gorgeous architecture of New Orleans where Southern charm and sophistication are abundant. We want our guests to have every modern convenience wrapped in Seaside and New Orleans architectural charm. All That Jazz has been completely transformed, and we can't wait for you to experience the new and improved Seaside classic. Come for the beach. Stay for the style. Come experience All That Jazz. ✨SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS ✨ (sleeps 8) 1st floor- Living Room with 65" flat screen television, Formal living room, Dining, Kitchen, Full Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) 2nd floor- • Bedroom 1: King, TV, outdoor balcony access. Private en-suite bath with separate garden tub and shower • Bedroom 2: Queen, TV, outdoor balcony access. Private en-suite bath with shower only • Bedroom 3: Full bed under built-in twin bunk, TV, hallway bathroom with shower only and Laundry Room Sprawling front porch and screened in back porch available 3rd floor- Tower daybed with beautiful views, traditional staircase to access tower Out the back door is an outdoor shower and grill and outdoor dining space for 6. If you are in need of a little more room, Creole (VRBO 291904), is the 2-bedroom guest cottage right next door. ✨IMPORTANT DETAILS ✨ Parking for 2 cars There is an additional cost to use the 3 pools and fitness center in Seaside. This charge is optional with Sandpiper Vacation Rentals. The cost for this cottage is $84/day. Seaside requires the passes to be purchased for the entirety of your stay when ordered. Seaside amenities: Playground, Pickleball Courts, Tennis Courts, Croquet Lawn, Basketball, 3 community pools including a covered pool, Adult only pool and Family pool, Chapel with Sunday services, Walkable Town Center from rental home including shopping, restaurants and upscale grocery market. Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Must be 25 to rent Not recommended for children under the age of 6 years old Sorry, no pets allowed No parties FREE WIFI

Amenities: High touch surfaces cleaned with disinfectant
Towels and bedding washed in water that's at least 60sC/140sF
